promptTemplate: A Pepper's ghost illusion in a dark proscenium: a phantom {{jelly_species}} jellyfish with {{pulse_tempo}}x respiration and {{tentacle_length}}px tendrils, witnessed through a {{refraction_pane}} pane with {{ghost_depth}} ghost displacement and stage dust {{stage_dust}}.

refraction_pane.hint: Aged glass surface texture and scatter

tentacle_length.hint: Extent of floating tendrils below bell

listing.blurb: A luminous phantom jellyfish floats over a dark Victorian theatre stage, refracted through an angled pane of illusion glass with drifting dust motes.
listing.prompt: A Pepper's ghost illusion: a transparent figure of light hovering in a dark theatre -- a luminous jellyfish made of drifting particles -- seen through an angled pane of glass, with faint reflections of the stage and a soft spotlight on the empty floor beneath it. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
